item.title: ACADEMY NEWS | Wrexham AFC launches two dedicated Academy social media accounts
item.description: Wrexham AFC are delighted to announce that the Club have launched two Academy social media accounts. The X and Instagram channels will provide coverage of the Club’s youth system, giving supporters a closer look at life within the Academy. These platforms will shine a light on the fantastic work that the Academy are doing, not just on the pitch to produce the players of tomorrow, but also highlighting what is happening off it through the various educational programmes. item.title: REPORT | Wrexham AFC 0-2 Millwall
item.description: An own-goal and Josh Coburn’s late strike handed Wrexham defeat at the SToK Cae Ras, as the Red Dragons were beaten 2-0 in North Wales. Despite a strong start, the visitors broke the deadlock through a stroke of fortune from Femi Azeez’s cross with 59 minutes played. item.title: SIGNED | Sarah Harvey signs for Wrexham AFC Women
item.description: Wrexham AFC Women are delighted to announce the signing of Canadian defender Sarah Harvey on a deal until the end of the 2025/26 campaign. Harvey, 30, has played in England, Canada, Georgia and Hungary, alongside playing in the UEFA Women’s Champions League qualifiers during her time in Georgia. She grew up playing grassroots football, before moving into semi-professional football in League1, while still in Canada. item.title: GALLERY | Wrexham AFC 0-2 Millwall
item.description: Wrexham AFC suffered defeat at home to Millwall, as the Red Dragons missed the chance to go level on points with the fifth-placed Lions. The hosts could not make a controlled first half count, as the sides went in goalless at the interval. Having already lost Matty James to injury in the first-half, Libby Cacace also hobbled off after the break. item.title: SIGNED | Maria Francis-Jones signs for Wrexham AFC Women
item.description: Wrexham AFC Women are delighted to announce the signing of Cymru international Maria Francis-Jones on a deal until the end of the 2026/27 campaign. item.title: INTERNATIONAL CALL-UPS | Wrexham AFC Academy duo named in Cymru youth squads
item.description: Wrexham AFC are delighted to announce that Under-16 Cynan Holdsworth and Under-15 Leo Saxon have been selected for their respective Cymru age group squads. Holdsworth will travel with the Cymru Under-16s to Cyprus to compete in the UEFA Development Tournament and will play against Romania, Scotland, and hosts Cyprus.
